task_completion.description: Agent successfully logs into the Nx Witness Desktop Client.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Nx Witness main interface is visible, showing the resource tree on the left and the 'admin' user logged in.

task_completion.description: A new layout is created and named 'Gate Monitor'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A tab or a resource tree entry labeled 'Gate Monitor' is visible in the client.

task_completion.description: Two instances of the 'Parking Lot Camera' are added to the layout.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Two video tiles are visible in the central viewing area, both showing the 'Parking Lot Camera' feed.

task_completion.description: One of the camera instances is digitally zoomed to show a region-of-interest (ROI).
task_completion.visual_evidence: One video tile shows a wide-angle view, while the other tile shows a significantly cropped/enlarged portion of the same scene (digital zoom).
The agent clicks 'Save' or the layout tab no longer has an asterisk (*) indicating unsaved changes; the layout appears in the 'Layouts' section of the resource tree.

integrity.description: The agent used the Nx Witness GUI rather than just executing terminal scripts to bypass the UI.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with the Nx Witness Desktop Client menus, dragging cameras, or using the zoom tools.

integrity.description: The agent used the specific 'Parking Lot Camera' as requested.
integrity.visual_evidence: The text overlay or resource name on the video tiles explicitly says 'Parking Lot Camera'.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply open a pre-existing layout named 'Gate Monitor'.
integrity.visual_evidence: The trajectory shows the process of creating a new layout, naming it, and dragging cameras into it.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The target layout name is 'Gate Monitor'. The required camera is 'Parking Lot Camera'. The layout must contain exactly two items: one full view and one digitally zoomed (ROI). The Nx Witness client uses port 7001 for its backend. Verification should confirm the zoom is 'digital' (cropping the view within the tile) rather than just resizing the tile itself.
